data.title: Will the Fed Raise Rates on September 16? Polymarket Now Says 83%. Here’s What It Means for XRP and Bitcoin
data.description: Polymarket odds on a September Fed hike have nearly tripled in three weeks, and the 10-year Treasury is already moving like the decision is done. What that tightening path does to XRP and Bitcoin on meeting day depends entirely on which outcome traders have stopped pricing in.
data.keywords: XRP, basis point, Fed decision days
